# Zepbound®

$1,399/month

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab69c_klarna.png)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab69b_afterpay.png)

[Benefits](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-0) [Description](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-1)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab054/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339abdb6_Chemistry.svg)

FDA-approved for weight management for patients with obesity.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab054/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339abdb5_syringe.svg)

Taken weekly with convenient, pre-measured auto-injector pens.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab054/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339abdae_checkmark.shield.svg)

No long-term contracts. Same price at every dose.

Zepbound is an injectable prescription medicine that may help adults with obesity, or with excess weight (overweight) who also have weight-related medical problems, lose weight and keep it off. Zepbound should be used with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity.

Zepbound™ is a GIP + GLP-1 medication that works by increasing feelings  of fullness, delaying gastric emptying, and regulating appetite. The convenient once-weekly dosing schedule is a major advantage that aids in helping people adhere to the treatment regimen and ultimately reach their goals. No more having to remember daily pills!

Zepbound contains tirzepatide and should not be used with other tirzepatide-containing products or any GLP-1 receptor agonist medicines. It is not known if Zepbound is safe and effective when taken with other prescription, over-the-counter, or herbal weight loss products. It is not known if Zepbound can be used in people who have had pancreatitis. It is not known if Zepbound is safe and effective for use in children under 18 years of age. Results may vary. Prescription required.

\*Results may vary. Prescription required. Visit [https://zepbound.lilly.com](https://zepbound.lilly.com/) for further information including safety information.

## Learn more about Zepbound®

What states do you serve GLP-1 programs?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

We are currently able to serve GLP-1 programs to all 50 states.

Is a long-term commitment necessary?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

Eden offers access to GLP-1-based solutions through a subscription service that you can cancel anytime. Our focus is on helping patients build sustainable habits and achieve lasting results by connecting them with qualified healthcare providers. Maintaining consistency in your treatment plan is key, but the choice remains flexible to suit your needs.

Can I use a GLP-1 with pre-existing medical conditions?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

Your healthcare provider will review your medical history to determine if GLP-1 products are appropriate for you. These medications may be prescribed to eligible individuals and can complement care for certain health conditions. Always consult with a qualified healthcare provider for guidance tailored to your unique health profile.

What if I'm pregnant and breastfeeding, or planning to get pregnant?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

No studies have been performed to determine safety of GLP-1s in patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding. GLP-1s should be discontinued for at least two months prior to becoming pregnant. It's always important to discuss any and all of the medications you're taking or planning to take with your doctor to ensure safety. Consult with your doctor before starting or stopping any medication.

Do your plans include prescriptions and medications?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

Yes, Eden's plans include the cost of the doctor's visit, prescription medications, and free shipping. Prescription medications are provided only after consultation with a physician to determine if the medication is appropriate for you. Eden offers a comprehensive package that includes ongoing support and regular check-ins to optimize your treatment.

Note: Compounded medications are prepared based on specific patient needs or in the event of drug shortages and are not reviewed or approved by the FDA for safety or effectiveness. Prescription required.

What is Eden's "Same Price at Every Dose" guarantee?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

Unlike other companies that may increase fees as your dose increases, we offer consistent pricing for every dose and medication. We are committed to democratizing metabolic health, making it affordable for everyone.

Please note: same dose pricing may not apply during promotional periods or discounts.

What medications do your doctors prescribe?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

Our network of partner physicians may prescribe FDA-approved and compounded medications. Other offerings may include peptide therapies and medications that support metabolism, recovery, or performance; based on clinical suitability and your health goals.

Note: Compounded medications are prepared based on specific patient needs and are not reviewed or approved by the FDA for safety or effectiveness. Prescription required. Results may vary.

Are in-person visits required?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

Nope! Your entire experience, from quiz to consult to delivery, happens online. Eden is designed for convenience, so you can access expert care from the comfort of your home.

Who are the providers at Eden?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

Eden partners with a national network of licensed doctors and nurse practitioners. Our team is trained in personalized, proactive care; offering expert, accessible support to help you feel your best.

Do you take insurance?

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab050/6a0ccac3db38d1a0339ab6fc_Plus.svg)](https://www.eden.health/treatment/zepbound#)

No, you don’t need insurance to make treatment accessible! Our care model is designed to make access straightforward and affordable without requiring coverage. You can use an HSA or FSA card for most visits and prescriptions.
